rejected_near_match.title: Preseason Integrative Neuromuscular Training Improves Selected Measures of Physical Fitness in Highly Trained, Youth, Male Soccer Players
why_rejected: The Crossref record was published online on 2022-11-30, before this registry record's actual 2024-01-14 study start.
Its listed authors are Hammami, Negra, Nebigh, Ramirez-Campillo, Moran and Chaabene, whereas the registered responsible investigator is Hazal Genc at Istanbul Medipol University Hospital.
Its abstract reports 24 participants, whereas NCT06203379 reports actual enrolment of 41.
The exact NCT identifier search did not retrieve it.

failure_evidence: The official public registry response has neither a document section nor results submitted or posted.
The official registry response has no linked publication references.
No lawful full-text results paper was identified through the exact identifier or exact-title searches.
records.next_step: Monitor the ClinicalTrials.gov record for posted results or a linked publication. For earlier access, contact the responsible investigator or sponsor and request the results publication, citing NCT06203379.
